IPT.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/6] Treatment sessions followed the outline of SLT presented in Goldstein's Skillstreaming the Adolescent (1980). Treatment consisted of a discussion of the skill to be covered, instruction on use of the skill, and group leader modeling of the skill. The adolescents then role played the use of the skill in social interactions typical of their familial environment.
